name: yanimation-playground
description: A pnpm monorepo for browser animation and code-driven video experiments.

scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm check-types && pnpm test:contracts && pnpm pipeline:check
scripts.test:contracts: pnpm --filter @yanimation/motion-tokens test && pnpm --filter @yanimation/motion-kit test && pnpm --filter @yanimation/animation-pipeline test
scripts.video:prepare: pnpm pipeline:check && pnpm --filter @yanimation/video-contract check && pnpm --filter @yanimation/remotion prepare:assets && pnpm --filter @yanimation/hyperframes prepare:compositions
scripts.video:check: pnpm video:prepare && pnpm --filter @yanimation/remotion compositions && pnpm --filter @yanimation/hyperframes lint:composition && pnpm --filter @yanimation/hyperframes validate
